==About==

A {{i|Hickory Nut}} can be Picked from a {{i|Hickory Tree}}, or found by chance when Rummaging though a {{i|Squirrel Stash}}. A {{i|Roasted Hickory Nut}} is obtained when using a Hickory Nut with the {{i|Roasted Nuts}} recipe, additionally, with the [[Nut Orchards]] Skill learned, a Hickory Nut can be planted in a {{i|Gardening Pot}} to grow a Hickory Tree. Planting in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. A Hickory Nut can be stored in a {{i|NutSack}}.
